description: This file defines a Spring Data JPA repository interface for accessing CreditBureauConfiguration entities. It includes custom query methods for retrieving configuration data based on specific attributes.

classes.name: CreditBureauConfigurationRepository
classes.description: A repository interface extending Spring Data interfaces for CRUD and specification execution for CreditBureauConfiguration entities. It contains custom query methods for retrieving configurations based on organization ID and keys.

methods.name: getCreditBureauConfigData
methods.description: Fetches a CreditBureauConfiguration based on organization credit bureau ID and configuration key.

methods.name: getCreditBureauConfigurationData
methods.description: Retrieves a CreditBureauConfiguration for a specific organization credit bureau ID.

methods.name: getCreditBureauConfigurationValueData
methods.description: Fetches a CreditBureauConfiguration based on the configuration key.
